description: ID checks, passport or driving licence, minimum age to enter
An admission ticket, e-ticket or booking confirmation that was lost or never arrived by email; not a personal belonging lost at the venue
Putting a ticket or booking in someone else's name
A ticket, barcode or QR code that is refused or will not work at the entrance gate
Buying extra tickets, upgrading a booking, or reselling a ticket
A wristband that is lost, broken or needs collecting
Driving to the event by car: the road address, drop-off point, car park and electric-car charging at the parking area; not walking directions between places inside the venue
Shuttle bus times, stops and tickets between the station and the location
Bicycle and scooter storage, trains and public transport times

Facilities available at the campsite or venue: toilets, showers, running water, shared cooking facilities and electrical sockets or power outlets, including cleanliness and queues; not permission to bring or use cooking equipment
Getting access to the campsite, cabin or lodge: waiting at the camping entrance, or a door code, key or lock that does not work
A visitor service specifically for charging a phone or renting a portable power bank at a phone charging point; not electrical sockets or charging an electric car in the parking area
Accommodation administration: check-in and check-out times and where to report on arrival; not a blocked door, lock or camping entrance
An urgent emergency involving a person who needs help right now: a missing child, daughter, friend or other person, someone collapsed, injured or unresponsive, a fire or a fight
Renting or reserving a locker and where to store luggage or a coat during the visit

A physical personal belonging lost at the venue, such as a phone, coat, bag or wallet, including when and near which stage it disappeared and where to collect it; not a missing person or admission ticket

Walking directions inside the event location: how to get from one venue spot to another, such as from a stage to the food trucks, and where a hall, exit, info point or first aid post is; not driving or parking
Noise that is too loud: stage volume, bass, or noisy neighbours
Leaving the site and coming back in again on the same ticket
House rules and permission: what you may bring in or use, including gas cylinders and cooking equipment, pets, glass, smoking and own equipment
Buying goods at a shop on the location: supermarket, kiosk, medicine, merchandise and souvenirs
Being treated rudely, unfairly refused or badly handled by staff or security
Managing a cashless card: topping it up, a failed or double charge, or checking how much credit remains; not requesting that remaining credit be paid back
Returning cups or glasses to get the deposit back
Food that fits a diet or allergy: gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, own food
Requesting money back, especially a refund of the remaining or unused balance on a cashless card, a deposit or a cancelled booking
Non-urgent programme news: when the next edition takes place or its tickets go on sale, and photos, recaps or aftermovies
What time something starts or ends, the timetable and side activities
